formFields.readOnly: Only Admin changes forms. You can see the fields here.
formFields.editHelp: The key, type and company can't change once the field exists. Every change goes into the transaction log.

f.label: Label
f.keyHelp: lowercase_snake: small letters and underscores only. Can't change later.

err.label: Enter a label.
err.key: Use small letters and underscores only, e.g. route_area.

removing.title: Switching a field off
removing.p1: A field is never deleted. Switching it off hides it from the form, and the values already saved stay on the records, so nothing is lost.
removing.p2: Fields that GST invoices and returns need (GSTIN, legal name, state, address, tax treatment) are built in and can't be switched off.

logged.title: Every change is logged
logged.p1: Adding, editing or switching off a field is kept in the transaction log with the old and new value, who did it and when.
logged.p2: Company law requires accounting software to keep this edit log for every change, and it cannot be switched off.
